purpose: Calibrate the procedural task and three non-candidate baselines before any local-memory mechanism is implemented.

data.entity_inventories: split-disjoint T, D and F namespaces
data.final_seed: one runner-random seed, unknown until audited execution

roles.dense_transformer_v1: six-layer, six-head, width-384 transformer lexical reader applied by a full statement scan; trained from scratch; public surface parsing and iterative traversal disclosed
roles.bm25_iterative_reader_v1: the same independently fitted reader after charged top-4 lexical retrieval per hop
roles.symbolic_last_write_graph_v1: raw-text parser plus last-write hash map and generic traversal

calibration_limitation: This bounded calibration uses a disclosed iterative reader scaffold rather than the future candidate-screen's one-shot 8192-token dense decoder. A pass validates task/control plumbing but does not certify that future dense reference implementation or any memory candidate.
metrics: overall exact match by K and D

terminal_rules.pass: If task and all controls pass, stop and identify one separately approvable local-memory experiment.
terminal_rules.negative: If learned quality fails with intact symbolic control, stop and revise or reject the learned baseline contract without test-guided rescue.
terminal_rules.inconclusive: On any missing cell, leakage, context error, timeout, OOM, crash, nonfinite value or integrity failure, preserve artifacts and stop without retry or replacement registration.
